title: Automated Versioned Asset Cache Invalidation & Authentic Billet Icons
summary: Synchronizes Service Worker cache versioning directly with package.json and adds query-based asset cache busting, ensuring newly updated material icons and atlas manifests are delivered immediately.

changes.text: Thumbnail Cache Invalidation: linked material thumbnail URLs to the current app version (`?v=v${version}`), preventing browsers and PWAs from holding onto stale cached beta icons (such as silver Midlander billets).

Automated Service Worker Version Sync: added a build/dev hook (`scripts/sync-sw-version.mjs`) that automatically synchronizes the Service Worker cache namespace (`VERSION`) with `package.json`, purging obsolete caches upon update.

Network-First Atlas Manifest Routing: updated Service Worker fetch strategy to retrieve reference manifests with `networkFirst` when online, preventing atlas metadata lock-in while preserving full offline functionality.
